henry.title: A Postcard to Dad in Scotland
henry.intro: Dad will be far away in Scotland. Write him a real postcard! A postcard is short: a greeting, 3 to 4 sentences, and a goodbye. (About 15 minutes.)
steps: FIRST (3 min): look at the Word bank on your worksheet. Pick 3 Scotland words to use.

NEXT (8 min): write the postcard on the worksheet. Start with Dear Dad, (capital D, comma). Write 4 sentences: (1) what you did this week, (2) one Scotland fact you learned, (3) one wee question for Dad, (4) 'I miss you.' End with Love, and your name.
THEN (3 min): draw the front of the postcard. You can look at the Scotland pictures (link) for ideas.
LAST (1 min): check: capital letters? periods? 3 Scotland words? You're done when you check all three!
Example sentences: This week I learned a drone on my ukulele. Edinburgh Castle is on a rock. Did you see a wee sheep?
links: Look at the pictures and pick one to draw on your postcard.
worksheet: Word bank: loch (lake), glen (valley), wee (small), bonnie (pretty), braw (great), kilt, castle, bagpipes, ceilidh (KAY-lee, a dance party)

frankie.title: A Postcard for Dad 💌
frankie.intro: Grown-up, read aloud: Frankie, let's make a postcard to send Dad in Scotland! (About 10 minutes.)
steps: Grown-up: read the picture words together: castle, sheep, rain, plane, heart.
Frankie draws a picture for the front. (Draw something Dad will see in Scotland.)
Frankie tells the grown-up one sentence for Dad. The grown-up writes it. Frankie traces DAD and writes his name. Done!
links: Grown-up: look at the pictures together to get ideas.
worksheet: Draw the front of the postcard 🖼️
